title: Per-instance identity (id+generation) and lifecycle observer (passive .dusk, Dusklight 2.0.3 Windows x64 DX12)

source.docs_commit: see git log of this branch (documents only, after compiled_source_commit)

hooks.install_order: POST then PRE; uninstall on PRE failure; disabled if rollback fails

identity.key: id (u32, sentinels 0/0xFFFFFFFE/0xFFFFFFFF rejected) + opaque ptr (never dereferenced or logged) + monotonic ledger generation (u64, never reused, 0 reserved) + epoch
identity.allocation: FREE, oldest RETIRED, oldest UNVERIFIED (CAPACITY_EVICTED), else CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED; ACTIVE/DEATH_SEEN never evicted
identity.origin: always UNDETERMINED for E_OC_CANDIDATE (DEVF Blue indistinguishable); NA otherwise

sweep.api: fopAcM_SearchByID(id,&out) read-only; out is the only pointer read

lifecycle.epoch: FNV-1a of first 8 bytes of dComIfGp_getStartStageName(); label only

writes: private mod memory and LogService lines only

artifact.direct_url_check: artifact id->run->name confirmed through the Actions API; the private web page was not opened

risks_not_tested: fopAcM_SearchByID behaviour in the real game (source says read-only; a live actor must never be reported absent)
mod_update ordering in the real exe
stage-name epoch does not see room changes inside a stage
DEVF Blue vs native E_OC indistinguishable
coexistence of POST02 with HM/Bars/DEVF not tested
